caption: The drawing depicts a small, vertically oriented handbag or purse constructed from a series of parallel, pink cords bundled at both ends. The upper section of the purse is attached to a large metallic ring, possibly for holding or hanging. The body of the purse consists of a tightly woven pink fabric. Around the upper portion of the main compartment, a decorative border made up of metallic, beaded loops is visible, and similar metallic beadwork forms a cascading fringe at the bottom, adding an intricate pattern. The drawing is centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background. At the bottom right corner is the name "Carl Buegermiss" written in small, neat handwriting.
title: Coin Purse
